figures.title: Recommendation match
figures.caption: Twenty unique additional cases, first scheduled repetition. Guarded error bars show the Wilson 95 percent interval. Model accuracy is not estimated.

figures.title: Validation effort
figures.caption: Actual validator invocations across all three repetitions on 20 additional cases. Only full method schedules are comparable. A failed model request is not a zero-effort successful review.

figures.title: Completed review time
figures.caption: Median elapsed milliseconds among completed reviews of additional cases. Whiskers show the middle half of observed times, not a confidence interval. Failed requests are excluded from successful-review timing.

figures.title: Completed review provider charges
figures.caption: Provider charges for completed additional-case reviews. Offline methods make no provider requests. An unresolved model charge is unknown, even when the ledger reports no billed amount.

figures.title: First-run outcome table
figures.caption: Outcome table for the first scheduled repetition on each additional case. R means ready, B means a blocking problem, V means further review. Error marks the failed request; N/A marks an unattempted review. Colors supplement text.

figures.title: Benchmark case categories
figures.caption: Forty synthetic cases. Expected categories stay outside model inputs. Independent label review is pending.

figures.title: Effort time and cost
figures.caption: Three repetitions on 20 additional cases. The failed model request provides no comparable effort, review time, or provider charge estimate.
